- **Takes:** #29871 (Claim 6601377851) and #29882 (Claim 6601398001), adopting the two dev threads the maintainer had already started. Other p1 `domain:server` cards: #29888 (`os-zhuang`) and #29041 (`os-warren`) left alone; #20645 is `pm:on-hold`.

|:--|:--|:--|
| #30038 item 3 | decision inbox, Release on the card | Waits for the maintainer's letter (analysis 6658088643, seat recommends A). |
| #30412 | decision inbox, Release on the card | Waits for the maintainer's letter (analysis 6658092417, seat recommends C). Since #30464 / PR #30593, a member added on the install answer's `data` needs a spec declaration too (spec#2, 6666252458). |

Not on GitHub: one security observation from the #30602 review went to security#1 (id-only Notify on its mailbox). The maintainer's Tier H todo from #30469 (ADR-0146 D3 / D11 text) is unchanged.

## Notes

- `post-stamped.mjs` refuses a `{{WAS:…}}` on the opening line of a `Release:` comment; put the reading in the body.
- A PR body edit through `issue_patch` needs the trailing `<!-- signed: … -->` line; `post-stamped --body` wants the signature first.
- A merge-conflict dequeue (#30551) was resolved by merging `origin/main` into the branch (no rebase), then a delta contract review on the new head and a fresh `automerge_enable`.
